comment: Read from the repository at commit ce83bfe, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. The module declares no parameters, no inputs and no outputs, so there is nothing on it to click apart from the panel itself; the two Note lines are all the entry can carry. MiniLab.cpp line 75 casts its left neighbour to a MiniLog and hands it each message before processing it, which is the whole of the connection: with anything else to the left, or nothing, the log stays empty and its light is off. The message buffer holds 512 entries and stops accepting when full, so a flood of messages is truncated rather than dropped from the front.
